Hannah: Following up on the postmortem: we split the remediation work into three cards. Need owners + concrete ETAs so we can track in the remediation board.
Devon: I'll claim REM-4401 (kv cache eviction tuning + telemetry). Will add a perf run plan and acceptance criteria by tomorrow.
Ravi: Good pick. Please include a regression job that runs monthly and a dashboard link.
Devon: Added both: monthly smoke job + dashboard. Acceptance: p95 < 90ms and sustained hit-rate > 92% on canary. ETA Fri-2024-06-14.
Keiko: I'll take REM-4412 (failover orchestration + runbook). Creating the Jira now and will scope dry-run steps.
Keiko: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REM-4412  created stub, ETA 4 business days.
Diego: REM-4425 (alert thresholds & autoscale knobs) requires eng-infra changes. Eng-infra owns the infra change, I'll verify. Diego (eng-infra) will post ETA by EOD tomorrow.
Hannah: Proposed RACI: REM-4401 R=Devon, A=Ravi, C=SRE, I=Oncall; REM-4412 R=Keiko, A=Hannah, C=Platform, I=PMs; REM-4425 R=Diego, A=Keiko, C=Eng-Infra, I=Customers. If no objections, I'll pin this in the tickets.
Ravi: Fine with that. One ask: tag tickets with "postmortem-action" and assign to the remediation board so compliance can see them.
incident-bot: Reminder: owners must add a due date and acceptance criteria to Jira within 48 hours.
Devon: REM-4401 updated with perf artifacts and test script. Tagged "postmortem-action" and added to remediation board.
Keiko: REM-4412 runbook draft uploaded; included rollback and a staged-canary checklist. ETA Tue-2024-06-18.
Diego: Eng-infra confirmed REM-4425 owner and set to Diego. ETA Thu-2024-06-13. I'll include a rollback toggle and monitoring play.
Hannah: I'll run weekly remediation syncs until these close, then hand off to monthly audits for three months. I'll add invites and a short agenda.
Ravi: Also suggest adding a short blameless note to each ticket summarizing the recurring pattern so future owners see the monthly spike history.
Devon: Done. I added the spike history and linked the incident timeline.
Hannah: Great work team. If a handoff is needed I can pair for the final rollout. :white_check_mark:
